headline.q1: **Q1:** In the 40–60 toss-up band (OOS n=614), backing the book underdog is still not a licensed strategy. Dog ML 220-390-2 / -9.1% (CI -18.9% to 0.7%). Model-side ML 322-290-2 / -8.1%. Book-favorite ML 390-220-2 / -0.5%. Dog ATS -110 300-297-20 / -4.1%. None of these CIs both exclude 0 and survive the season + Bonferroni bar.
headline.q2: **Q2:** Confident buckets are not a usable betting surface. Book-favorite ML when the model is >60% home: 378-146-1 / -2.2% (CI -7.5% to 3.5%). When the model is <40% home: 188-119-2 / -10.9%. Model-minus-book ≥5pp ML: 258-267-2 / -3.0% (CI -11.9% to 6.1%). The raw confident buckets and the disagreement filter both fail the strategy bar. That matches the health-check diagnosis: the model is overconfident, not quietly +EV at short prices.
